raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 27 duplicate txn_ids are amount corrections: raw_transactions holds a record_version 2 row alongside the original record_version 1 row, as the 2026-01-18 payments-source note describes. silver_transactions keeps both versions, so each corrected transaction is counted twice in silver and in every gold table built from it. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id, and applying the POSTED filter after that dedupe, gives the corrected record and also handles a correction whose status changed.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1) AS latest WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
